name: mcp-prqx-pricer

tools.name: GetProductions
tools.description: Get productions by production name, venue, performer, city. Within a range of dates (StartDate, EndDate). Only retrieves a maximum of 10 items

filter.description: Filter to be applied to the production search (Name, Venue, Performer or City) separated by spaces

startDate.description: Start date of the production search (YYYY-MM-DD)

endDate.description: End date of the production search (YYYY-MM-DD)

productionStatus.description: Status of the production ("Active","Inactive","Cancelled","Postponed", "All") - Include only Active if not specified

tools.name: GetProductionInventory
tools.description: Get all the organization inventory (ticket groups) for a single production

tools.name: GetPricingGroups
tools.description: Get the organization pricing groups for a single production

productionId.description: ID of the production that the pricing group will be created for

ceilingPrice.description: Maximum price that the pricing group tickets can have

floorPrice.description: Minimum price that the pricing group tickets can have

pricingGroupMode.description: (AutoPrice or SimulationOnly) Mode of the pricing group

amount.description: Amount used to price the anchor ticket of the pricing group based on the first market comparable

increment.description: (increase or decrease) Decides if the amount is applied to increase or decrease the price of the anchor ticket of the pricing group based on the first market comparable

incrementMethod.description: ( % or $ ) Decides if the amount is applied as a percentage or a dollar amount

offsetAmount.description: Offset amount used to price the other tickets in the group based of the previously ranked ticket

offsetIncrement.description: (increase or decrease) Decides if the offset amount is applied to increase or decrease the price of the other tickets in the group based of the previously ranked ticket

offsetIncrementMethod.description: ( % or $ ) Decides if the offset amount is applied as a percentage or a dollar amount

enableShareOptions.description: Decides if the pricing group will control the sharing of tickets in a marketplace or not

shareOptionsType.description: (all or custom) Decides if we use custom parameters to share the tickets in the group or if we share them all. Default all.

shareAnchor.description: Controls if the anchor ticket of the pricing group will be shared or not

customSharingAmount.description: Custom sharing amount use to determine which tickets to share of this pricing group

customSharingMethod.description: ( $ or % ) Decides if the custom sharing amount is applied as a percentage or a dollar amount.

applyCeilingOnlyToAnchor.description: Decides if the ceiling price will be applied only to the anchor ticket of the pricing group

applyFloorOnlyToAnchor.description: Decides if the floor price will be applied only to the anchor ticket of the pricing group

floorPricingMethod.description: (standard, variable, useFloor or floorRandomize) Decides what method to apply for pricing when the market comparable for the pricing group hits the floor price

ceilingPricingMethod.description: (standard, variable, useCeiling or ceilingRandomize) Decides what method to apply for pricing when the market comparable for the pricing group hits the ceiling price

noCompPricingMethod.description: (standard, variable, ceiling, freezePricing, useFloorForAnchor, useCeilingForAnchor, useCeiling, ceilingRandomize) Decides what method to apply for pricing when there is no market comparables for the pricing group

pricingGroupRequestRanks.description: Array of objects containing pricing group request ranks starting at 0 (anchor ticket). i.e [{"ticketGroupId": 1, "rank": 0},...]

tools.name: DeletePricingGroups
tools.description: Delete multiple pricing groups in bulk

pricingGroupIds.description: Array of IDs (numbers) of the pricing groups that will be deleted. They can belong to multiple productions.

tools.name: UpdatePricingGroup
tools.description: Allows to update any individual property of an existing pricing group
